links.surface: الحسن بن عيسى بن محمد بن علي بن جعفر

notes: The first name in the text is al-Kulayni, the compiler's shaykh; the text writes him as a transmitter, so he is an ordinary narrator (rule 13). The tool adds al-Nuʿmani
«عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link with the name alone (rule 7); the Imam named after «عن» stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)
«(قال) قلت: يا سيدي» continues the same saying: no second isnad

levels.surface: الحسن بن عيسى بن محمد بن علي بن جعفر

notes: «- رحمه الله -» is a blessing and is not part of the surface
«أخيه موسى بن جعفر» is one link: the surface is the name alone (rule 7); Musa is written as a narrator, not an imam_in_text, because he stands inside the chain after «عن»
the second half («قلت: يا سيدي، مَن الخامس...») has an unnamed questioner; he is not a link and the Imam's answer closes the chain
